info.title: ACME Bank Dispute Portal API
info.description: Transactions (debit orders and card), mandates, disputes and notifications for the signed-in customer. All endpoints under /api require a Keycloak access token with the 'customer' role. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents with a stable 'code' and a 'traceId'.

post.summary: Raises a dispute against a debit order or a card transaction. Requires an Idempotency-Key header, which makes retries safe.

get.summary: Lists the customer's disputes, newest first. Filter by state to get pending or completed disputes.
Returns one dispute with its progress timeline.
Lists the dispute reasons the customer can choose for one of their transactions, each with the scheme's code for it.
Lists the customer's inbox, newest first.
Returns how many notifications the customer has not read.

post.summary: Marks a notification as read. Safe to repeat.

get.summary: Lists the customer's debit order mandates, optionally by type.
Lists the customer's transactions of one type, newest first, with whether each can be disputed.
Returns one transaction with the details of its type and its dispute eligibility.

bearer.description: A Keycloak access token for a user with the 'customer' role.
